ticket_number_extraction.description: 6-digit ticket number appears after the 'TICKET NO.' label in the upper section of the ticket.
ticket_number_extraction.ticket_number_ai_hint: The ticket number on Troutdale Sand & Gravel tickets appears in the upper right corner after the label TICKET NO. It is typically 6 digits. IMPORTANT: The ticket number font on Troutdale tickets is thin and difficult to read. Common misreads are: the digit 0 (zero) looks similar to 2 in this font; the digit 9 looks similar to Q or 3 in this font. Look very carefully at each digit in the TICKET NO. field. Zero has a closed oval shape. Two has a curved top and flat bottom with a horizontal stroke. Nine has a loop at the top and a descending stroke. Double-check your reading of any digit that could be 0 vs 2, or 9 vs 3.

notes.ticket_number: 6-digit number on the line following 'TICKET NO.' in the upper section of the ticket.
notes.date: Date appears after the 'DATE:' label in format MM/DD/YY (2-digit year). Normalise to MM/DD/YYYY (4-digit year) — e.g. '11/17/25' → '11/17/2025'. Assume 2000s (20YY).
notes.supplier: Always 'Troutdale Sand & Gravel' for this supplier.
notes.slump: Numeric value after 'Slump:' label near the bottom left of the ticket. Example: 'Slump: 4.00 lu' → 4.00. Return null if absent.
notes.qty_delivered: Use 'QUANTITY THIS LOAD' as the per-load cubic yards delivered (not 'QUANTITY DELIVERED' which is a cumulative total). Units are YD (cubic yards).
notes.helper_notes: Product description from the 'PRODUCT DESCRIPTION' line. Example: '6.5SK 4000'. Include the full description text.
notes.excel_columns: A=Ticket Date, B=Logged Date, C=Supplier (always 'Troutdale Sand & Gravel'), D=Slump, E=Qty Delivered (YD), F=Ticket #, G=Helper Notes (product description), H=Human Notes (leave blank)
